minor.issue: seed_all is guarded only by meta.seeded flag. If an admin/test deletes programs after seeding, startup never recreates them -> empty programs even though users remain. Consider: skip seeding only if programs exist, or seed each entity idempotently like admin user does.

issues: document.scrollWidth slightly > innerWidth. Likely from recharts tooltip layer or chart padding. Not visually disruptive but worth checking.

action_items: (optional) Make seed_all idempotent-per-entity so missing programs/indicators are re-seeded even if meta.seeded flag exists.
(optional) Investigate ~1px mobile horizontal overflow on Dashboard (recharts ResponsiveContainer in YoyCard grid).
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard() builds two full report sets (reports + prev_reports + all_reports) and iterates programs twice to compute yoy_trend and yoy_spm. OK for current scale (<10 SPM) but if indicators grow large, consider precomputing aggregate once per (p,i,m).
aggregate(..., [m]) is called twice per indicator per month (for trend + yoy). Memoize if dataset grows.
status_bulanan uses all_reports (includes drafts) which is correct for the grid; good distinction from REPORTED-only data used for aggregates.
